item.title: Swimming for Beginners
item.description:
Build water confidence and learn proper swimming technique in the safety of your own society pool.

What You’ll Learn

  • Water safety and confidence building
  • Freestyle stroke technique
  • Backstroke fundamentals
  • Treading water and endurance

Requirements

  • Basic comfort in water
  • Swimwear and goggles
  • Parents must be present for children under 8
